description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProfilerListener' that subscribes to Symfony kernel events to add profiling and debugging functionalities, including injecting scripts into HTML responses and tracking redirections.

classes.name: ProfilerListener
classes.description: A class that listens to Symfony kernel events to profile requests, inject debugging scripts, and track redirections.

methods.name: onKernelRequest
methods.description: Handles kernel request event to add event to the debug profiler.

methods.name: onKernelController
methods.description: Handles kernel controller event to add event to the debug profiler.

methods.name: onKernelResponse
methods.description: Handles kernel response event to add profiling, inject scripts, and modify response content.

methods.name: onKernelTerminate
methods.description: Placeholder for handling kernel termination event.

methods.name: onKernelException
methods.description: Placeholder for handling kernel exception event.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of subscribed kernel events with their handler methods and priorities.
